design: Same binary, receiver peer, track, volume, loop state and codec. Consecutive 900-second windows with fresh bot starts; start phases differed (about 64 vs 84 s) and bot ages differed. No SSH administration during qualified windows. Historical source-tail reference reused, not fresh waveform alignment. Setup reports preserved, never pooled into valid windows.
limitations: One pair is a screen, not proof of rare-loss reduction.
Sender-host sampling is at one-minute intervals; no packet tracing during measurement.
decision: No demonstrated raw-loss benefit; DSCP remains disabled by default. Services and collectors stopped after preservation; production remains inactive and disabled.
